source.author: verg
source.text: Hic duo rite mero libans carchesia Baccho fundit humi, duo lacte novo, duo sanguine sacro, purpureosque iacit flores, ac talia fatur:
source.text_original: Hic duo rite mero libans carchesia Baccho / fundit humi, duo lacte novo, duo sanguine sacro, / purpureosque iacit flores, ac talia fatur: /
source.text_english: Here, duly pouring out two goblets of unmixed wine to Bacchus, he pours two on the ground with new milk, two with sacred blood, and scatters purple flowers, and speaks as follows:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ipse ter aequoreo libans carchesia patri sic ait Aesonides:
reuse.text_original: ipse ter aequoreo libans carchesia patri / sic ait Aesonides:
reuse.text_english: Then Jason himself, pouring out three libations from the sea-faring cups to his father, spoke thus:
